title: Uncertainty of waveguide cut-offs by Monte Carlo (2D)
description: Manufacturing tolerances of a dielectric-filled rectangular guide (a, b, eps_r with stated standard deviations) propagated through the finite-difference eigen-solver by Monte Carlo: mean, standard deviation and 95 % interval of the TE10 and TE20 cut-offs, the sampling error of the Monte Carlo itself, against first-order (GUM) propagation with the closed-form sensitivities.

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: TE10: Monte Carlo std vs first-order GUM]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: JCGM 100 eq. 10 with df/da = -f/a, df/deps = -f/(2 eps) (Pozar eq. 3.84))

metrics.name: rel_error[2D: TE10: Monte Carlo mean vs nominal]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (closed_form: Pozar eq. 3.84 at the nominal dimensions (FD discretisation error included))
